text:
Hi everyone! 😊 I’m hoping someone here might have gone through a similar situation and can point us in the right direction.

We’re currently in the process of applying for a B1 partner visa. We’ve already had our interview, and everything went well. The officer told us that we passed, but there’s one document still missing: a physical apostilled copy of my CENOMAR.

Here’s where we’re stuck:

> I have the original physical CENOMAR.
> I also have the apostilled version as a PDF/e-document.
> I’m supposed to fly back to the Philippines to get a physical apostilled copy, but when I called today to book an appointment, I was told that they no longer issue physical copies of apostilled CENOMARs, only the electronic version.

The Ministry of Interior told us they can’t approve my visa without a physical Apostilled copy, and unfortunately the PDF would not suffice, even if it’s a valid document, they still want to see a physical copy.

Has anyone else been in this situation? If so, what did you do? Is there another way to obtain a physical apostilled copy here in Israel, or is there an alternative document or process that was accepted? I’ve also already called the Philippine Embassy in Tel Aviv and they said that they do not do Apostilles there. 

Any advice or shared experience would be greatly appreciated. Thank you so much! 🙏🤍
